modules.description: Core forensic analysis engine for bibliographic and manuscript integrity over PhilPapers 2026 and A6 livro_vfinal.

functions.name: compute_md5
functions.description: Generates MD5 hex hash for file integrity verification.

functions.name: detect_duplicates
functions.description: Identifies duplicate file pairs based on MD5 content hashes, returning (path1, path2, md5).

functions.name: verify_manifest_entry
functions.signature: verify_manifest_entry(path: str, expected_author: str, expected_title: str) -> Dict[str, bool]
functions.description: Reads the header of a text file and checks whether expected_author and expected_title match, flagging anomalies.

functions.name: tabular_tail_ratio
functions.description: Computes the fraction of numeric/tabular lines in a document to detect massive numeric appendices.

modules.description: SQLite persistence and CLI entrypoint for corpus audit runs.

functions.name: save_audit_sqlite
functions.signature: save_audit_sqlite(db_file: str, records: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int
functions.description: Persists audit_records (file, anomaly, md5, dado_count) into SQLite.

functions.name: run_corpus_scan
functions.signature: run_corpus_scan(phil_dir: str, a6_book: str, db_file: str) -> Dict[str, Any]
functions.description: Scans all PhilPapers txt files and A6 livro_vfinal.md and persists results.
